name: Ahmad bin Hassan
bio:
Ahmad's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly. As a young apprentice in a Kuala Lumpur machine shop, he stumbled upon a team preparing a rally car. Fascinated by the intricate work and the raw power of the engine, he offered his assistance and quickly proved his knack for fabrication. He learned the ropes from seasoned mechanics, honing his skills in welding, machining, and composite materials. He is now a trusted member of the Iron Dames, known for his meticulous approach and ability to craft bespoke components under pressure.

Ahmad's philosophy is simple: 'Precision is paramount.' He believes that every part, no matter how small, contributes to the overall performance and reliability of the car. His ambition drives him to constantly seek improvements and explore innovative solutions. While adept at traditional techniques, he is also keen to embrace new technologies and materials, making him a valuable asset in the ever-evolving world of motorsport. His loyalty to his team and his unwavering dedication to his craft are what truly set him apart.

physical.description: Ahmad is a man of sturdy build, with a calm demeanor and a focused gaze.

quirks: Always sharpens his welding rod to a perfect point before starting.
Insists on using only Malaysian-made tools whenever possible.
Constantly hums traditional Malaysian folk songs while working.
